newsitem.title: NIGERIA: ADC shares fall on Nigerian bourse after crash.
newsitem.headline: ADC shares fall on Nigerian bourse after crash.

text.p: Shares of Aviation Development Company (ADC) whose Boeing 727 jet crashed on Thursday killing 141 people dropped four percent on the Nigerian stock market on Friday, dealers said.
Traders observed a minute silence in honour of victims.
The shares lost 20 kobo to 4.40 naira.
"The market's reaction is normal. The same thing would have happened anywhere else in the world," said one broker.
ADC shares were trading steady at 4.60 naira before the crash after falling because of the difficult climate in which Nigerian airlines was operating, traders said.
ADC, floated by a group of Nigerian pilots, is the only quoted aviation company in the country.
